subject: Urgent: Production latency spike — incident-time log preservation & chain-of-custody
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finservco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: FinServCo SOC <soc@finservco.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloud-integrator.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Production latency spike — request for log preservation and chain-of-custody

Marcus —

We observed a large latency and error-rate spike affecting our payment workflow between 08:46–09:05 PDT this morning. Our SRE and SOC teams need assurance that logs and telemetry covering that window are preserved immediately and that you can attest to chain-of-custody for any artifacts you provide (timestamps, checksums, who accessed the artifacts, any redaction steps).

Please confirm all of the following:
- Which raw logs you have captured (request traces, access logs, KV-cache events, generated outputs) and whether request/response bodies or PII were logged.
- Whether you can produce an immutable archive and SHA256 hashes.
- How long you will retain the preserved archive (we need 90 days minimum for our internal review).
- Where we can download evidence (S3 link or secure transfer) and any PoA/attestation we can use for internal audit.

This incident is elevated to our exec team (they're asking for an initial preservation attestation within 4 hours). Please cc support and security contacts.

Thanks,
Dana Liu
Sr. Platform Engineer — FinServCo
Dana.Liu@finservco.com

--

Team — forwarding FinServCo's request. Execs expect an attestation within 4 hours. Immediate asks: preserve everything for 08:30–09:20 PDT, create an immutable archive with checksums, capture access logs and any debug dumps we generated during mitigation. 

Monica: can you own customer comms and the attestation?
Sean: can you run an immutable snapshot and provide SHA256 hashes + list of included files. Note any content that contains request/response bodies or PII so we can propose redactions.
Rishi: loop in Legal if we need POA language or to craft a formal attestation. Also advise on sharing controls (S3 presigned vs secure transfer) and whether the archive can be reconstituted without privileged keys.

Mark me as exec escalation if they push on SLAs. I'll join the call if needed.

Thanks — Marcus

Working notes (SRE):
- Window captured: 2026-10-01T08:30:00Z -> 2026-10-01T09:20:00Z (UTC timestamps attached in manifest).
- Included artifacts:
  * request_traces/trace-20261001-08*.ndjson (full request/response headers, bodies only for truncated sampling; most bodies are not persisted beyond 10KB by default — note for SOC)
  * access_logs/redwood-frontend-20261001.log.gz (ip, path, response_code, latency_ms)
  * kv_cache_evts/kv-evts-20261001.log (cache hits/misses, evicted keys metadata, no payloads)
  * runtime_metrics/prom-20261001-*.prom (metrics series)
  * debug_dumps/jit-kernel-dump-1001.bin (binary kernel state snapshot)

- PII exposure: request_traces may contain user identifiers (user_id) and occasionally hashed tokens; we do not store raw payment card data. We will flag all trace files that contain user-identifying fields and provide a redaction plan.

Actions completed:
- Created immutable archive: s3://redwood-preserve/FS-2026-0943/immutable-archive-20261001.tar.gz
- Generated SHA256 manifest: s3://redwood-preserve/FS-2026-0943/immutable-archive-20261001.sha256 (attached as preservation_manifest_20261001.txt).
- Access log for the archive creation and uploader: preservation_manifest_20261001.txt includes username, timestamp, and CIDR of upload host.

Next steps:
- Produce a short CSV timeline for FinServCo and attach the manifest + checksums.
- If FinServCo requires 3rd-party notarization, we can coordinate an S3-to-secure-transfer and provide the signed manifest.

FYI legal status / control notes:
- Legal is on standby for a preservation attestation. We'll need the following in the draft attestation: description of preserved artifacts, preservation time window, storage location (S3 path), SHA256 checksums, list of Redwood personnel who created and accessed the archive, and standard limitation language about not retaining customer content beyond agreed retention without approval.
- For sharing: prefer a short-lived presigned S3 URL restricted to FinServCo's IP CIDR; if they insist on notarized transfer, we can coordinate with our partner (Amit Shah) for secure exchange.
